name: tracker-planning-stage-follow-through
goal: Prove feature briefs require sequential planning, and owner Hub item details preserve the same stages and artifacts as Mac and iPhone without leaking private Tracker records.

evidence: The Tracker CLI and signed journal already expose stages. A launched feature brief omits required promotion steps, and Hub strips planning fields before rendering item details. Keep Mac and iPhone behavior and the existing owner-only Hub scope.
Strengthen native brief and creation tests, the fixed Tracker read privacy case, Hub owner snapshot round trip, and the published item-detail browser case at all three viewports.
